items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Cotton Club, '75, co-arranger with Phil Moore. ... And you and Phil Moore did the arranging. Phil Moore and Pete Meyers and Gil Laskey.

ctx.x: That's from Duke's first Sacred Concert.

Yeah. And it came off well, because we used it on the, 'Love You Madly,' TV show. That was another good team to work with, with Quincy Jones, Phil Moore, Luther Henderson, Marvin Hamlisch. I don't mean to just drop names, but --
That's interesting. No, it's important. This is all part of your career.
